notes.title: 78th anniversary, with the Korean version and the theme song released.
notes.notes:
Taipei, Taiwan - The digital adaptation of the popular board game "Raid on Taihoku" is now available on Steam. Set in Japanese-occupied Taiwan in 1945, the game allows players to control an amnesiac female high school student and a Taiwan Dog as they embark on an adventure in a city ravaged by the US Army bombings. In the process of getting back her memories, she also encounters unexpected threats.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42023174/56c4a72d5245b39690398990fe2378cccd06b3c0.png
Raid on Taihoku is now launching its Korean version coinciding with the 78th anniversary of the historical event.

On May 31, 1945, over a hundred American bombers conducted a devastating airstrike on Taipei, resulting in severe casualties. This year marks the 78th anniversary of the event, and the Korean version will be released in late May.

Producer CHANG, SHAO-LIAN expressed that the Korean translation was undertaken by a team of 42 individuals led by Assistant Professor LEE, Jung-Min from Chinese Culture University (CCU), known as "Team BPMF." The translation process took three months to complete.

Assistant Professor LEE, Jung-Min is a prominent scholar in the field of comparative literature with a strong interest in colonial history. After playing "Raid on Taihoku," he was highly impressed and believed it to be excellent research material. As a result, he proposed the idea of translating the game into Korean to the production team.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42023174/0183ce438f2bf0b316c92cab782d0c878534ea8c.jpg
Team BPMF led by Assistant Professor LEE, Jung-Min

Professor LEE further explained that both Korea and Taiwan were both former Japanese colonies, but their perspectives on this historical period differ. Koreans tend to adopt a more negative stance, while Taiwanese lean towards discussing this part of history from a more positive angle. Due to the lack of understanding among many Koreans regarding Taiwanese perspectives, Professor LEEbelieves that "Raid on Taihoku" has the potential to serve as an opportunity for Koreans to gain insights into the Taiwanese viewpoint. He hopes this game will help Korean players deepen their understanding of Taiwan.

Coinciding with the 78th anniversary of the Raid on Taihoku, the MV for the game's theme song, "When The Sky Returned," written by musician Enno Cheng, has also been released. Enno Cheng expressed how the protagonist, Kiyoko, constantly stares into space as if looking into a distant past inspired her. Through this song, she aims to bring back the voices emanating from a faraway memory for her listeners, inviting the players to the game and the emotions it brings.

"When The Sky Returned" MV link: https: //youtu.be/JUPCozcOoCI

"Raid on Taihoku" was developed by Mizogames and Fun2 Studio and published by Loftstar Interactive Entertainment. It is now available on Steam and ready for interested players to join the experience.

notes.title: Raid on Taihoku - Update v1.0.4.3
notes.notes:
Dear player,

Thank you for playing "Raid on Taihoku." We have been working hard and continuously collecting feedback from players in order to make the game more polished and enjoyable. The content of this update is as follows:

Optimizations:


Added a button in the safe zone of levels to activate the running function (keyboard/mouse/gamepad).


Updated the layout of the operation page and added running instructions.


Split some longer dialogues that cannot be skipped into two sentences to facilitate player information reading.

Fixes:


Fixed the issue with automatic detection of Simplified Chinese language causing problems. Simplified Chinese language will now display correctly when playing the game.


Fixed the issue with the "The Real Kuro" side mission where players couldn't interact with the cat correctly.


Fixed the problem of seeing NPCs disappear due to the updated running content.


Fixed the problem of characters being stuck/unable to walk due to the updated running content.

We hope that these adjustments can enhance your gaming experience. "Raid on Taihoku" is currently on sale, with a 20% discount till 4/8.

If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to contact our team or fill out our bug report form, and we will be happy to assist you.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfaF15YgthsFtcO9z18GPMIP947mBrzlbZNGPPETVjfpOh8EA/viewform

We wish you a pleasant gaming experience!

notes.title: 1.1 Demo Version Update
notes.notes:
Thank you for your valuable feedback after playing the “Raid on Taihoku” game demo. We listened to your feedback and have discussed it. The game demo has been updated with :

1. Optimized game performance
2. New game scene elements
3. Fixed problem of getting stuck while model glitching
4. Temporarily removed keyboard controls

We hope that these improvements create an enjoyable gaming experience for you. If you have any thoughts or suggestions, let us know what you think here. We really appreciate your feedback and are looking forward to hearing more future feedback from you in the future.

notes.title: Raid on Taihoku 77th anniversary. "When The Sky Returned" Full Version Released
notes.notes:
May 31st, 1945. Countless American B-24 bombers fly towards the capital of Taiwan – Taihoku.

May 31st, 2022. 77 years have gone by since the Raid on Taihoku. We hope all the pain from the past can be comforted as time flies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42023174/3df6037f98c7b79043d20b3c3ebdacc8b7407e58.jpg

In this memorable day, we are proud to announce that the theme song in Raid on Taihoku – "When The Sky Returned", has been released on every mainstream music streaming platform.

"When The Sky Returned" is a song specifically tailored for Raid on Taihoku byEnno Cheng. In the song, he gently whispered to all the people who have been hurt and bears unforgettable scars.

Besides the original song in Mandarin, we have a Japanese version translated. We hope to learn more oversea gamers about this part of the Taiwanese history through the song.

Meanwhile, we’d like to announce that the demo version of Raid on Taihoku will be released along with the much-anticipated Steam Next Fest. More announcements regarding the updates of the game will be released very shortly. Stay tuned.
